Concert series "Cat in a Sack - for children
description:
Village square concert series "Cat in a Sack - Moseg and more..." 2026 - for children

Saturday, July 18, 2026, from 11:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m
“A pig in a poke” for children with “magical” entertainment

The popular format “Cat in a Sack” – Moseg and more is being held especially for children this time. As usual, it is only announced a few days before who will surprise the children, how and who will host the young and old visitors. We can already reveal this much: it will be a “magical” surprise and there will be delicious food from the P… oven.

If the weather is bad, the event will take place in the foyer of the community hall.

title: Viera brass brass music of the highest quality from Tyrol
description:
Viera Blech - top-class brass music from Tyrol

Viera Blech from Tyrol, founded in 2004, consists of seven top musicians with degrees. The formation stands for brass music at the highest level and will be performing live for the first time at Burg Gutenberg in Balzers in 2026.

title: Balzner World Cup Schtoba - food and games
description:
World Cup final with food & games

If you would like to experience the 2026 Football World Cup final on the big screen with other fans, we invite you with the “Vinören”, first to the village square and then to the “WM-Schtoba” in the community hall.
The program:
5:30 p.m. - 9:00 p.m.:    Warm up with food and games on the village square: food and drink, served
from the “Vinören”; Playing at the Chuttekashta and at the gaming station
9:00 p.m. - midnight:    World Cup final on the big screen in the chilled out “WM-Schtoba” in the community hall
with a wide selection of drinks

If the weather is bad, the entire program will take place in the community hall from 5:30 p.m. to midnight.
